worldcombat.skill.soak.summary: Pour a torrent of water over the target and wash its whole type away into pure Water; the flood option also drenches the ring around it and soaks the ground into mud.
worldcombat.skill.soak.use.0: wash the target's type and STAB into Water
worldcombat.skill.soak.use.1: open Electric and Grass weaknesses while shutting down Fire and Ground STAB
worldcombat.skill.soak.use.2: drench a whole ring of foes at once
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.0: Wash all of the target's current types into pure Water for %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.1: Pour range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, following speed and size.
worldcombat.skill.soak.description.2: Splash radius about %1$s blocks, soaked soil lingers %2$s; larger and heavier bodies show more.
worldcombat.skill.soak.flood.on: Flood: splash out to %1$s blocks at %2$s cooldown, drenching the target and the ring around it, but each lasts shorter and the wind-up is slower.
worldcombat.skill.soak.flood.off: Trickle: one target only, drench lasting %1$s, faster and cheaper to cast.
worldcombat.skill.soak.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
On = Flood: drench the target and the ring around it and lay wider mud, but each lasts shorter and wind-up and cooldown are longer; off = Trickle: one target, longer duration, faster and cheaper. Coverage trades against duration.
worldcombat.skill.soak.preference.ai.max: The companion only considers drenching a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases further.
worldcombat.skill.soak.preference.ai.lea: When on, it will leave its post to drench the target.
world_combat.move.soak.text.dry: The water dries; its type returns
world_combat.move.soak.text.fizzle: Already pure Water, nothing to drench
